direction: Painted American roadside-pulp illustrations presented as handmade printed cardboard standees. Preserve the approved coral, turquoise, mustard, cream, swamp-teal and spectral-mint palette. Every asset is isolated on genuine transparency, includes a thin irregular cream paper cut edge, has a clean readable silhouette, and contains no baked floor shadow, base, labels, logos, watermark, UI, or surrounding scene.

assets.review: Complete battered cone and base remain readable at game-board scale; transparency verified.
